sara: Heads up — deploybot failed to publish the prod image for release/2026-03-21. Deploy halted by provenance guard.
vik: Ugh, what was the error?
sara: Deploybot log snippet: `publish rejected: provenance.attestation: missing field 'build_meta.build_id' (manifest_digest: sha256:9f3b...)`
ash: Is that the new attest schema that we rolled out last week?
sara: Yeah looks like the builder didn't attach the new annotation to the manifestlist. GCR/ECR both rejecting because our provenance linter enforces it.
deploybot: NOTICE: publish blocked -> image: gcr.io/redwood/services/api:canary-20260321, action: hold, reason: provenance.attestation.missing_field, manifest: sha256:9f3b..., canary: skipped
vik: Can we fallback to the last pinned digest to keep the release moving?
release-ops: We have a change window open for 30 more minutes. If we can roll forward w/ corrected metadata quickly that's ideal; otherwise pin to prev digest and document hotfix.
ash: Quick option: repush same image but with an injected `build_meta.build_id` label and re-run cosign attestation. Command I used earlier: `crane mutate --annotation org.opencontainers.image.revision=BUILD1234 gcr.io/...@sha256:9f3b...` then `cosign sign-blob --annotations build_meta.build_id=BUILD1234` (pseudo).
sara: Trying that in staging now. If it succeeds I'll replicate to prod and notify deploybot to retry.
deploybot: ACTION: retry-publish requested by sara
vik: If the repush fails or takes >20m we should pin to sha256:6a7d... (previous prod digest) and unblock. Need to update release notes & open PROV ticket.
release-ops: Agreed. Plan: (1) attempt repush with annotation (10m), (2) if success -> resume canary + smoke tests, (3) if fail -> pin to previous digest and proceed with release, create PROV-1234 to republish corrected image during next change window.
ash: If we pin, remind QA to mark the regression in the changelog so downstream teams know there was a metadata-only republish planned.
sara: Staging repush succeeded with new annotation and attestation. Kicking off a prod publish retry now.
deploybot: NOTICE: publish accepted -> image gcr.io/redwood/services/api@sha256:9f3b...; canary deploy started
vik: Nice. Can we add a brief bullet to the release notes: "Temporarily blocked publish due to missing provenance metadata; republished with correct attestation (PROV-1234)"
release-ops: I'll add that and schedule PROV-1234 for a postmortem during next retro.
sara: Thanks team. Closing the hot alert. :white_check_mark:
release-ops: Follow-up: PR to builder image to include build_id annotation by default in next CI patch (assign ash).
